games.name: Monster Chase
games.pitch: Something is following you down a haunted forest path. Stay ahead, sprint or lean to dodge its lunge, and pedal hard to break free.
games.trains: steady pacing, repeated surges and hard sprints, all scaled to your own FTP
features: sprint or lean to escape (camera, tablet tilt or rocker plate)
the path's hills set your trainer

games.name: Absolute Adrenaline
games.pitch: Fuel your own race with every watt you put down. Steer with your head, fight for first place, and ride away with a new PR. The most adrenaline a stationary bike can give you.
